outOfScope: Changing BB-078 detached-operation, BB-079 async-result-context or BB-080 coordinator semantics to make the held-out result pass.
Changing product WHAT, Application/domain authority, Oracle source ownership, Jev/QA authority or EffectOperation truth.
Using development Terminal-Bench tasks, post-result replacement tasks, best-of-k selection or vendor benchmark numbers to decide promotion.
Treating B or C ablation arms as supported product profiles; they exist only for attribution.
Running BB-074 end-to-end delivery-value acceptance inside BB-081. BB-074 is downstream and consumes the profile decision after BB-081.
constraints: Every A/B/C/D arm uses the exact BB-077 Harbor adapter/substrate, model/provider profile, task instruction, starting environment, capability names/input schemas, per-attempt budgets, measurement contract, artifact extraction and Harbor verifier. A profile-neutral benchmark capability binder is identical across arms; only the intended synchronous-vs-detached/context/coordinator behavior may differ.
The external held-out cohort is exactly the four Terminal-Bench 2.1 task digests reserved by BB-077. Development tasks, replacement tasks and task mutation after observing results are forbidden.

Run exactly two independent repeats per held-out task and arm. The registered evaluation unit is task digest + repeat index + frozen profile hash; all 32 arm attempts remain in the denominator and accounting.

The 32-attempt live ablation must remain inside BB-077's USD 25 cohort ceiling and USD 0.60 per-attempt ceiling. Budget exhaustion yields an incomplete/INCONCLUSIVE cohort; it cannot trigger task deletion or threshold changes.

Fault robustness uses deterministic local/provider/tool/process fixtures, not additional paid live-provider sampling, so fault semantics and replay safety are reproducible and isolated from provider randomness.
Accepted quality cannot be traded away for savings. The exact BB-077 D-vs-A quality/safety/efficiency gates are frozen before held-out results and are conjunctive.
B and C are diagnostic attribution arms only. The promotion candidate is D = A + delivered BB-078 + BB-079 + BB-080; only D may become CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1.

Unknown/missing cost or token accounting, missing registered arm/repeat, verifier drift, source/profile mismatch or prerequisite blockage yields INCONCLUSIVE; missing values are never coerced to zero.
All attempts, failures, retries, timeouts, rate limits and human interventions remain append-only evidence. No best-of-k, success-only filtering, retry replacement or outlier deletion is permitted.

CORE_SYNC remains implemented/exported/regression-tested regardless of the decision. Rollback applies only at a new/quiescent session boundary after in-flight async operations/effects are terminal or reconciled.

Worker execution requires BB-077/078/079/080 DONE and exact delivered artifact/Living-doc bindings. Any incompatible delivered capability composition yields PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION and returns to research.
BB-074 is not an input authority for BB-081: its end-to-end delivery-value experiment is downstream of this profile decision and must not be used to tune BB-081 thresholds.
invariants: Async scheduling and prompt optimization cannot become correctness, product-acceptance or external-effect authority.
Every detached operation remains bound to exact call/turn/action/effect identity and unresolved effect ambiguity fails closed.
Efficiency claims require matched evidence with fixed model, task semantics, tool surface and resource budget.
architectureDecisions: D1 — BB-081 is acceptance/attribution/publication only. It must not modify the delivered BB-078/079/080 semantics, BB-077 benchmark contract or product acceptance/effect authority to make a candidate pass.

D2 — Freeze four compositional arms: A=CORE_SYNC; B=A+BB-078 detached-operation capability; C=B+BB-079 append-only/cache-stable async-result context; D=C+BB-080 steering/wakeup/recovery coordinator. B/C are diagnostic only; D is the sole promotion candidate.

D3 — Arm composition is capability-manifest driven. Worker bootstrap resolves exact DONE BB-078/079/080 exports and constructs the four profiles without source mutation. If an independently toggleable B/C/D composition cannot be built from delivered APIs, stop with PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION rather than approximate attribution.

D4 — Make detachment observable without changing the model's tool names or input schemas. BB-081 defines one profile-neutral benchmark effect binding over the exact delivered BB-077 shell/fixture capability: all arms expose the same capability name/input contract and a predeclared terminal-or-operation response union; A invokes the bound effect capability synchronously and therefore emits the terminal branch, while B/C/D wrap that exact capability through delivered BB-078 and may emit RUNNING. The binder uses deterministic operation identity and an explicit conservative replay policy; it is identical across arms and cannot special-case tasks.

D5 — The dependency/bootstrap gate must prove that at least one held-out-relevant BB-077 capability can be bound to BB-078 without changing task instruction, capability name/input schema or verifier semantics. If delivered BB-077/078 seams cannot satisfy this, BB-081 is PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION rather than a zero-treatment ablation.

D6 — Use the four Terminal-Bench 2.1 held-out tasks reserved in BB-077 by exact digest: git-leak-recovery, pypi-server, kv-store-grpc and sanitize-git-repo. BB-077's oracle/nop validation, fresh reset, Harbor adapter and leakage rules remain authoritative.

D7 — Run two independent repeats per task/arm, yielding 32 registered arm attempts and staying under BB-077's USD 25 cohort ceiling even at the USD 0.60 per-attempt cap. Pair every comparison by exact task digest + repeat index + fixed benchmark profile hash.

D8 — Counterbalance four-arm execution order with an eight-sequence balanced schedule: git-leak r1 A-B-D-C/r2 C-D-B-A; pypi r1 B-C-A-D/r2 D-A-C-B; kv-store r1 C-D-B-A/r2 A-B-D-C; sanitize r1 D-A-C-B/r2 B-C-A-D. Each arm occupies each ordinal position exactly twice across the cohort.

D9 — Reuse HARNESS_RUN_RECORD_V1 and BB-077 measurement/failure taxonomy unchanged. The report extends each record only with ablationArm, dependencyManifestHash, repeatIndex and faultScenarioRef; it does not redefine quality, token/cache accounting or causal timing semantics.

D10 — The primary live decision compares D against A only. B and C are used to compute marginal attribution vectors A→B, B→C and C→D for quality, normalized cost, prompt tokens, model turns, elapsed time, overlap/cache observations and failure fingerprints; no B/C result can independently publish a supported profile.

D11 — Preserve BB-077's primary gate exactly over the registered task-repeat units: D accepted-task rate >= A; duplicate external effects = 0 and all required recovery negatives pass; median D/A normalized provider-cost ratio <=0.85; prompt-input-token ratio <=0.90; model-turn ratio <=1.00; elapsed ratio <=1.10.

D12 — Define accepted-task rate over the registered comparison unit already frozen by BB-077: exact task digest + repeat index + profile hash. With four held-out tasks and two repeats, each arm has denominator 8. Retries remain attempts inside that unit and never create a replacement unit.

D13 — The live cohort is a bounded engineering experiment, not a significance claim. Report all eight paired D/A observations, medians/distributions, per-task repeat consistency and optional descriptive bootstrap intervals; do not convert repeated rollouts into best-of-k or claim statistical superiority from n=8.

D14 — Fault robustness is a separate deterministic matrix over frozen synthetic fixtures. It injects provider timeout, 429, ambiguous completion, tool failure, process kill/restart, cancellation, duplicate operation transition/wakeup and external-effect ambiguity at declared boundaries. Fault results are not mixed into paid external task economics.

D15 — Fault scenarios apply only where semantically meaningful: provider/tool failures have A-D controls; durable-operation kill/restart and cancellation target B-D; duplicate transition/context delivery targets C-D; duplicate wake/model-generation fencing targets D; external-effect ambiguity/replay fencing targets B-D. Unsupported scenario/arm cells are N/A, not passes.

D16 — Promotion safety is absolute for D: zero duplicate external effects; no lost terminal result; cancellation never claims an unresolved external effect cancelled; stale/fenced model output dispatches zero actions; NON_RECONCILABLE ambiguity escalates/fails closed; restart preserves exact operation/effect/generation identity. Any conclusive violation => KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE.

D17 — Reliability is observed from repeated independent registered units. Report per-task 0/2,1/2,2/2 acceptance consistency and failure-fingerprint recurrence. A repeated run is evidence about variance, not permission to select the better outcome.

D18 — Separate measurement, deterministic decision and publication. run.mjs emits append-only live/fault evidence; accept.mjs consumes only the frozen cohort/manifests/gates and returns PROMOTE_ASYNC, KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE or INCONCLUSIVE; Jev independently validates the exact claims/evidence but cannot rewrite the reducer outcome.

D19 — Publish a narrow package-level execution-profile contract only after the deterministic decision. CORE_SYNC is always supported; CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 is selectable only after PROMOTE_ASYNC. createAgentRuntime() defaults are not silently changed; downstream BB-066 must resolve the exported supported profile explicitly.

D20 — Profile evidence binds exact BB-077 benchmark contract hash, held-out protocol hash, dependency delivery hashes for BB-078/079/080, provider/model profile hash, evaluated source SHA and decision artifact hash. Any later mutation invalidates the evidence-backed claim and requires a new acceptance cohort.

D21 — KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE is a valid completed BB-081 outcome: publish CORE_SYNC as supported and retain async components as non-default/experimental capability. INCONCLUSIVE is not acceptance-complete and publishes no supported-profile change.

D22 — BB-074 remains downstream. BB-081 decides Core execution-profile support from harness-level evidence; BB-074 later tests whether the integrated delivery system produces end-to-end human/value improvement without feeding those results back into this frozen gate.

D23 — Public methodology evidence is supporting context only. Beyond Pass@k (arXiv:2608.14711) shows independent rollouts are required to measure reliability and a single-rollout proxy can be misleading; The Scaffold Effect (arXiv:2607.22585) supports fixed-model harness-specific cost/latency/failure reporting. Neither paper nor any vendor result decides ExHarness promotion.

expectedDependencyOutputs: BB-077 DONE: exact Harbor adapter/substrate, held-out registry, HARNESS_RUN_RECORD_V1, provider/budget/measurement/failure contracts and synchronous control evidence.
BB-078 DONE: exact independently composable detached-operation manager/store, transition/recovery/cancel APIs and delivery judgment.
BB-079 DONE: exact independently composable async-result context checkpoint/provider-delivery APIs and delivery judgment.
BB-080 DONE: exact independently composable async-agent coordinator steering/coalescing/model-fencing/recovery APIs and delivery judgment.

implementationSlices: S1 — Dependency/tool-surface bootstrap gate: resolve exact DONE BB-077/078/079/080 implementation-result/judgment/Living refs, compute one dependency manifest hash, bind the delivered BB-077 held-out-relevant capability through one identical effect-aware benchmark binder, and reject missing/incompatible/non-composable/zero-treatment contracts with PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

S2 — Ablation profiles: construct A/B/C/D from the same bound benchmark capability surface without modifying dependency source; A executes the effect-aware capability synchronously, B/C/D detach the exact capability through BB-078, then C adds BB-079 and D adds BB-080. Freeze held-out digests, repeat/order schedule and fixed model/provider/budget hashes.

S3 — Live held-out runner: execute all 32 registered arm attempts through the shared BB-077 Harbor adapter with fresh trial/runtime/provider session identity and HARNESS_RUN_RECORD_V1 accounting; preserve every retry/failure and block development/replacement tasks.

S4 — Attribution report: produce pair-complete A→B, B→C, C→D and D/A vectors for quality, economics, context/cache observations, turns, latency/overlap, repeat consistency and failure fingerprints without one aggregate winner score.

S5 — Deterministic fault matrix: run local provider/tool/process/replay fixtures at preregistered boundaries, record N/A cells explicitly, and prove D safety/recovery requirements plus component-level attribution for B/C/D.

S6 — Deterministic gate reducer: consume only frozen manifests and complete evidence to emit PROMOTE_ASYNC, KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE or INCONCLUSIVE; mutation tests cover missing pairs, unknown accounting, threshold/task/profile drift and every primary gate.

S7 — Profile publication: add execution-profile.js/export tests; keep CORE_SYNC always supported and expose CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 only on PROMOTE_ASYNC with exact evidence/dependency binding and quiescent rollback semantics.

S8 — Living truth: update Core-harness state/workflow with only the actually verified decision, limitations, rollback boundary and evidence binding; no async value claim is published for INCONCLUSIVE.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Worker execution binds exact DONE BB-077/078/079/080 delivery artifacts and can construct independent A/B/C/D profiles from delivered exports without mutating dependency source; incompatible/non-composable deliveries fail PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

A/B/C/D expose the same held-out-relevant capability name/input protocol through one identical effect-aware benchmark binder; A synchronously reaches terminal output while B/C/D exercise the exact delivered BB-078 detached path without task-specific behavior or a changed verifier.
evidenceRequired: A terminal-before-return vs B/C/D RUNNING-before-terminal timeline

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Held-out live mode admits exactly the four BB-077-reserved Terminal-Bench digests, two repeats and the frozen eight-sequence four-arm schedule under the unchanged BB-077 fixed-factor/provider/budget/verifier contract.

All registered units, attempts, retries, provider failures and unknown usage remain append-only HARNESS_RUN_RECORD_V1 evidence; missing accounting stays null/reason and cannot be filtered, replaced or converted to zero.

The report exposes matched A→B, B→C and C→D marginal vectors plus D/A primary vectors for quality, cost/tokens, turns, timing/overlap, cache observations, repeat consistency and failure fingerprints without one opaque aggregate score.

The preregistered deterministic fault matrix covers every declared provider/tool/process/cancel/duplicate/replay boundary with explicit applicable arms and N/A cells, preserving independent quality and exact failure taxonomy.
D cannot be promoted with any duplicate external effect, lost terminal result, unsafe cancellation, stale-model dispatch, duplicate wake turn storm or unresolved NON_RECONCILABLE ambiguity.
evidenceRequired: reducer KEEP_SYNC cases for every conclusive safety regression

acceptanceCriteria.statement: On the complete eight registered D/A task-repeat units, D accepted-task rate is no lower than A under the unchanged independent Harbor verifier; repeats are counted independently and never best-of-k selected.

PROMOTE_ASYNC requires all BB-077 primary D/A efficiency gates simultaneously: median normalized provider cost <=0.85, prompt-input tokens <=0.90, model turns <=1.00 and elapsed time <=1.10, with complete known accounting.

The deterministic reducer returns only PROMOTE_ASYNC, KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE or INCONCLUSIVE; missing pairs, budget stop, unknown primary accounting or binding drift produce INCONCLUSIVE and no worker/vendor/Jev prose can override the reducer outcome.

CORE_SYNC remains always supported; CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 is published only after PROMOTE_ASYNC with exact protocol/dependency/source/decision binding, while B/C remain diagnostic and createAgentRuntime defaults are unchanged.
evidenceRequired: export/profile tests for all reducer outcomes

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Rollback to CORE_SYNC affects only new/quiescent sessions and cannot reinterpret or duplicate in-flight async operation/effect state.
Benchmark/ablation/profile/cache state cannot become correctness, product-acceptance or external-effect authority.
evidenceRequired: negative proof that benchmark/profile state cannot confirm EffectOperation or product acceptance

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Every detached operation remains bound to exact call/turn/action/effect/generation identity and unresolved effect ambiguity fails closed throughout held-out fault/recovery probes.
Efficiency claims are valid only for the exact frozen matched held-out protocol; any model/provider/task/budget/profile/dependency mutation invalidates comparison and requires a new cohort.
evidenceRequired: binding mismatch fixtures for all frozen dimensions

invariantCoverage.invariant: Async scheduling and prompt optimization cannot become correctness, product-acceptance or external-effect authority.
Every detached operation remains bound to exact call/turn/action/effect identity and unresolved effect ambiguity fails closed.
Efficiency claims require matched evidence with fixed model, task semantics, tool surface and resource budget.

negativeVerificationCases: A development, replacement or mutated task enters the held-out cohort after candidate work exists.
An arm changes model/provider, instruction, starting environment, tool surface, per-attempt budget, Harbor adapter, measurement contract or verifier in addition to capability composition.
A/B/C/D expose different capability names/input schemas or arm-specific prompt/tool descriptions in order to explain async handles.
BB-078/079/080 modules are installed but no held-out D unit actually invokes a detachable capability, yet the reducer treats the D/A economics as evidence for PROMOTE_ASYNC.
The benchmark effect binder assigns different semantic operation identity or replay policy by arm for the same task/repeat/capability input.
B/C/D cannot be independently composed from delivered dependencies but the benchmark approximates the missing arm instead of returning PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
One arm reuses another arm's workspace, provider session, runtime/coordinator state or prior model output.
A failed/rate-limited/retried attempt is dropped, overwritten or replaced by a later success.
Two repeats are collapsed into best-of-k/task-any-success rather than both registered units remaining in the denominator.
Missing provider token/cost/cache fields are converted to zero or inferred from stable-prefix bytes.
A 33rd paid arm attempt is scheduled outside the frozen 32-unit live cohort without a new protocol.
A deterministic fault scenario is silently retried with a live provider and mixed into paid external economics.
An N/A fault cell is counted as a pass.
PROMOTE_ASYNC is emitted when D quality regresses, any primary efficiency gate fails, required accounting is unknown, or a required D fault assertion is missing.
PROMOTE_ASYNC is emitted with duplicate effects, unsafe cancellation, lost terminal result, stale-model dispatch, duplicate-wake turn storm or unresolved effect ambiguity.
B or C is published as the supported product profile based on a marginal improvement.
INCONCLUSIVE publishes CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 or changes createAgentRuntime defaults.
Jev prose, worker summary, vendor benchmark or BB-074 downstream evidence overrides the frozen reducer.
Rollback changes an active async session before pending operations/effects are quiescent/reconciled.
A later source/profile/dependency mutation retains old evidence binding and still claims the changed async profile is supported.

exact READY plan + DONE direct dependencies

livingDocs.statement: BB-081 Living Docs publish only the independently verified supported Core profile decision, exact evidence/dependency binding, limitations and quiescent rollback semantics. INCONCLUSIVE does not publish an async support claim.

researchEvidence.finding: Current READY BB-077 freezes Harbor v0.23.0, Terminal-Bench 2.1 held-out digests, two-dimensional quality/failure accounting, exact provider/per-attempt/cohort budgets, repeat-index comparison units, measurement semantics and D-vs-A future promotion thresholds that BB-081 must reuse rather than tune.

Phase contract explicitly requires A=sync, B=+detached operations, C=+cache-stable context and D=+steering/recovery under one fixed comparison contract, with repeated/fault runs and promotion based on quality-cost-latency-recovery rather than pass rate alone.

READY research defines detached-operation scheduling with durable RUNNING-before-launch, generation fencing, replay-policy-aware cancellation/recovery and synchronous fallback. These are expected dependency seams only until BB-078 is DONE.
READY research defines append-only async-result context, provider delivery modes and stable-prefix accounting. These are expected dependency seams only until BB-079 is DONE.
READY research defines steering, durable ingress/coalescing, model-generation fencing, stop/restart recovery and no-heartbeat behavior. These are expected dependency seams only until BB-080 is DONE.

Current EffectReplayPolicy and reconcileEffectOperation remain external-effect recovery authority; benchmark/fault/profile state cannot synthesize confirmation or silently retry NON_RECONCILABLE ambiguity.

The candidate passes a predeclared quality non-regression bound and cost/token improvement gate or the decision is KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE.

ablationContract.composability: Profiles are assembled only from exact DONE exported capability seams. Failure to independently compose B/C/D is PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
ablationContract.evaluationUnit: exact held-out task digest + repeatIndex + frozen benchmark profile hash
ablationContract.fixedFactors: Exact BB-077 Harbor/model/provider/task instruction/environment/tool surface/per-attempt budgets/measurement/artifact/verifier contracts.
ablationContract.accounting: All registered units and all attempts/retries remain visible. No replacement/best-of-k. Per-task repeat acceptance is reported as 0/2,1/2,2/2.

heldoutContract.preflight: Reuse BB-077 admission proof: oracle 5/5, nop negative and exact digest/environment identity. If delivered BB-077 proof is absent/stale, BB-081 must re-run preflight before any held-out model dispatch.
heldoutContract.leakage: Only the four reserved held-out digests are permitted. Development tasks or newly authored/replacement tasks are rejected.
heldoutContract.reset: Fresh Harbor trial/environment, ExHarness runtime/coordinator state and unique provider session_id per arm/task/repeat unit.

faultMatrix.mode: deterministic fixtures only; no paid provider calls

assertions: failure classified provider/termination, never quality-rejected without verifier candidate
no unverified model result becomes authoritative

scenarios.boundary: fenced model returns after user steering

faultMatrix.naRule: Scenario/arm cells outside the declared arms are N/A and excluded from pass counts; N/A can never be converted to success.
faultMatrix.promotionSafety: All D-applicable safety assertions must pass and duplicate external effects must equal zero.

decisionContract.quality: accepted-task rate over registered task-repeat units: D >= A; no registered unit may be dropped
decisionContract.safety: D duplicate external effects == 0 and every D-applicable recovery/cancel/stale-model/lost-result/ambiguity assertion passes
decisionContract.diagnosticAttribution: Report A->B, B->C, C->D marginal vectors and per-task repeat consistency; these never override primary D/A gates.
decisionContract.promote: Complete 32-arm live cohort + complete required deterministic D fault evidence + quality pass + safety pass + every efficiency gate pass.
decisionContract.keepSync: Evidence is complete/known and any primary quality, safety or efficiency gate conclusively fails.
decisionContract.inconclusive: Missing registered arm/repeat, cohort budget stop, unknown primary cost/token accounting, verifier/task/profile/dependency drift, incomplete required fault evidence or invalid binding.
decisionContract.authority: Frozen deterministic reducer only. Jev independently judges evidence claims but cannot select a different profile outcome.

profiles.CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1: A+B+C+D delivered composition; selectable only after PROMOTE_ASYNC.

profilePublicationContract.diagnosticRule: B/C may exist in benchmark composition only and are never exported as supported product defaults by BB-081.
profilePublicationContract.selection: PROMOTE_ASYNC => supported=CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1; KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE => supported=CORE_SYNC; INCONCLUSIVE => no publication/change.
profilePublicationContract.noImplicitDefault: BB-081 does not silently change createAgentRuntime() default behavior. Consumers resolve the exported supported profile explicitly.
profilePublicationContract.rollbackBoundary: New/quiescent session only after all in-flight async operations/effects are terminal or reconciled.

toolActivationContract.purpose: Guarantee that A/B/C/D differ on a real held-out-relevant operation rather than only on installed-but-unused async modules.
toolActivationContract.capabilitySource: Exact delivered BB-077 shell or fixture capability used by the Harbor adapter.
toolActivationContract.responseContract: One predeclared union visible in every arm: terminal result OR durable operation handle/update. A synchronously emits terminal results; B/C/D may emit RUNNING/late terminal behavior from delivered async layers.
toolActivationContract.effectBinding: The benchmark binder creates one exact effect-aware capability with deterministic operationKey bound to task/repeat/arm-independent semantic call identity and an explicit replay policy. Binding logic is byte-identical across A/B/C/D.

armBehavior.A: Invoke the bound effect capability synchronously through CORE_SYNC.
armBehavior.B: Wrap the exact bound capability with delivered BB-078 detached-operation manager.
armBehavior.C: Same B binding plus delivered BB-079 async-result context.
armBehavior.D: Same C binding plus delivered BB-080 coordinator.

toolActivationContract.activationProbe: Before paid held-out dispatch, a deterministic fixture must prove A waits for terminal completion while B/C/D receive a durable RUNNING handle before the same delayed effect completes, with identical capability name/input binding and one semantic effect id.
toolActivationContract.externalCohortCheck: For each held-out task/repeat, record whether the detachable capability was actually invoked. A registered D/A unit with zero detachable invocations remains in quality accounting but is excluded from causal detachment-efficiency attribution; if all eight D units have zero detachable invocations, the profile decision is INCONCLUSIVE because the treatment was not exercised.
toolActivationContract.failClosed: Cannot bind delivered capability, schema differs by arm, effect identity differs by arm, or all D units exercise zero detachable calls => INCONCLUSIVE/PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION as applicable; never PROMOTE_ASYNC.
